item.title: Artificial Intelligence answering non-emergency sheriff's calls
item.description: Non-emergency calls to the San Diego County Sheriff's Office are being answered by an artificial intelligence processing system beginning this weekend.

item.title: Longtime Congressman Darrell Issa announces retirement
item.description: After more than 25 years in Congress, Rep. Darrell Issa announced he will retire, opening the door for a new race in Southern California’s 48th District as leaders reflect on his legacy.

item.title: San Diego's Forecast for March 7, 2026: Spring forward before warm and windy weather Sunday
item.description: Don't forget to move those clocks an hour forward because Daylight Saving time takes effect at 2 a.m. Sunday! That means we lose an hour of sleep but gain an hour of sunlight.
